messages:
maria_p: Quick kickoff — we need to lock the launch criteria and scope for the tenant-bounding + multi-region routing initiative by EOD Thursday. Sales pushed a handful of enterprise asks (region pinning, per-tenant SLAs, hard isolation option). Can we sketch must-haves vs nice-to-haves and call out blockers?

raj_s: Thanks. Top customer asks I heard: 1) guaranteed region residency (EU-only), 2) per-tenant throughput contracts, 3) ability to opt into hard isolation (no noisy neighbors), 4) audit logs + KMS integration.

alex_w: For each ask we need a clear acceptance test and a perf target. e.g., region pinning = 99.9% of requests routed to EU region for pinned tenants; per-tenant throughput = sustained X RPS/tenant w/o affecting p95 of shared pool.

sarah_k: Proposal for launch criteria (MVP):
- Routing: region pinning + soft-affinity routing that favors local region but falls back on failure.
- Isolation: soft tenant bounding (cgroup/GPU pool quotas) + an opt-in hard slice for top customers.
- SLAs: latency SLOs published per-tier; must have rollback path to a lower-cost model variant.
- Observability: per-tenant latency/cost dashboard + audit trail.
- Testing: canary + chaos test (simulate region outage) pass.

kevin_r: Resource note: hard-slice option needs dedicated pools (N GPUs per slice). Quick back-of-envelope: 5 hard slices * 8 A100s ~= significant capex. Need to model expected committed spend before proposing.

maria_p: OK can we separate into M1 (must ship) / M2 (priority) / M3 (post-launch)? My draft: M1 = region pinning + soft tenant bounding + basic SLA docs + canary rollout. M2 = per-tenant throughput contracts + stronger isolation + cost dashboards. M3 = automated tenant migration playbooks + self-serve isolation. Thoughts?

raj_s: Agree. Minor tweak: include audit logs + KMS for M1 if a customer is blocking on compliance. Otherwise M2.

alex_w: Technical constraints: soft-affinity routing implemented today via weighted routing rules in the router layer. Hard slices require scheduling changes and improved KV-cache locality. Also need a way to pin KV cache to slice — otherwise cold starts will spike latency.

sarah_k: Acceptance test checklist (short):
- Pinning: create tenant T with region EU, run 100k requests, verify >=99.85% served from EU.
- Soft bounding: create 50 tenants, throttle tenant X to 10x traffic, verify others' p95 change < 5%.
- Hard slice: deploy tenant to dedicated pool, verify no cross-tenant CPU/GPU usage.
- Failover: simulate region down, verify failover < 2s for routing decision and no data loss for in-flight streams.

kevin_r: Add cost acceptance: rolling 30d cost delta for shared pool < +15% when enabling soft bounding at scale. If hard slices then show committed spend model.

maria_p: We need owners: 
- Routing policy & fallback: alex_w
- Isolation & slices: raj_s
- SLAs & docs + product acceptance: maria_p
- Observability + dashboards: sarah_k
- Capacity + costing: kevin_r

alex_w: Quick config proto for routing rule (WIP):
```
route: {
  tenant_id: "T123",
  pin_region: "eu-west-1",
  fallback: ["same-region-pool","global-overspill"],
  affinity_weight: 0.95
}
```
This needs policy evaluation hooks for per-tenant overrides.

raj_s: On hard-slice opt-in UX: sales needs a simple checkbox + SLA tier mapping. Backend should accept a slice_request, run preflight capacity check, then provision. Preflight must check GPU availability and KV affinity.

ops-bot: Canary job queued for routing-policy canary. job_id=canary-2026-04-12-7, status=queued :hourglass: 

maria_p: Next steps: alex/raj/sarah to sketch concrete acceptance tests in a doc by Tue COB. Kevin to provide a 90-day cost model for soft vs hard isolation by Wed. I'll consolidate and send to leadership Thurs morning. Anything missing? :thinking_face:

alex_w: I'll add the KV locality notes — without it hard slices look risky.

raj_s: I'll draft the provision API + migration path.

sarah_k: I'll wire up the dashboard mockups and tests. :thumbsup:

kevin_r: Will pull cost numbers and include committed spend scenarios.

maria_p: Thanks — marking owners in the tracker. We'll sync Wed 10am for blockers.
